% 20.03.2026 1. Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 42/2021 of PS Madhu Vihar for offence under Section 498A/406/354/377/34 IPC on the ground that the complainant de facto (respondent no.2) has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.
2. Learned APP for State accepts notice and strongly opposes this petition in view of heinous allegations levelled in the FIR.
One such allegation is that the petitioner inserted screwdriver in the private parts of their 1 years old daughter.
3. Respondent no. 2, identified by IO/Inspector Pramod Kumar, accepts notice and submits that the allegations mentioned in the FIR are truthful.
This is a digitally signed order.
